title: Coarse-Graining and Long-Range Response in Generated Systems
summary: Coarse-graining should retain the response to the perturbations and observations of interest. We study this requirement for systems defined by generating operations and observation maps. Equality of all allowed future outputs defines an observation-sufficient quotient; fibre consistency gives differentiable descent for bounded surjective linear maps between Banach spaces. Linearising the state equation and the observation together produces a response whose kernel, source, readout and direct term transform consistently under coarse-graining.
